title: relay_queue cleanup_orphan_msg_files ignores .msg.tmp and .env.tmp
description: SmtpRelayQueue.cleanup_orphan_msg_files() skips files that don't end with .msg (line 197: 'Only consider plain .msg files, not .msg.tmp'). This means .msg.tmp and .env.tmp files from a crash-during-enqueue are never cleaned up. NntpQueue.drain_once handles this inline for its own .tmp files, but SmtpRelayQueue.start_drain calls cleanup_orphan_msg_files then drain_once — drain_once only looks at .env files so .tmp files accumulate without bound across restarts. Trigger: process crash between write and rename of .msg.tmp or .env.tmp during enqueue. Bad behavior: .tmp files accumulate indefinitely in the queue directory, consuming disk space.
